gloss: new school (after transfer); school one transfers to

definitions.gloss: new school after transfer; destination school
definitions.explanation: the school a student moves to when transferring from one school to another

examples.japanese: {転校先|てんこうさき}はもう{決|き}まった？
examples.english: Have you decided on your new school yet?

examples.japanese: {転校先|てんこうさき}の{学校|がっこう}で{友達|ともだち}ができるか{心配|しんぱい}だ。
examples.english: I'm worried about whether I'll make friends at my new school.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}の{転勤|てんきん}で{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すことになり、{転校先|てんこうさき}を{探|さが}すのに{苦労|くろう}した。
examples.english: Due to my father's job transfer we had to move, and it was a struggle finding a new school.

notes:
Composed of {転校|てんこう} (school transfer) + {先|さき} (destination). The suffix {先|さき} is commonly used to indicate where something is directed: {引越|ひっこ}し{先|さき} (place one moves to), {就職先|しゅうしょくさき} (place of employment), {旅行先|りょこうさき} (travel destination).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転校先|てんこうさき}の{学校|がっこう}: the new school
- {転校先|てんこうさき}が{決|き}まる: the new school is decided
- {転校先|てんこうさき}を{探|さが}す: to look for a new school
- {転校先|てんこうさき}で{慣|な}れる: to get used to the new school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転校|てんこう}: school transfer — the act of transferring itself
- {転入先|てんにゅうさき}: place of enrollment — more formal/administrative term for the receiving school
- {転校生|てんこうせい}: transfer student — the student who transfers
